div.span: C4 · Level 3 — Components of the agent

div.span: The agent’s threads and modules: a sampling loop, an ipc server with one thread per connection, handlers that never panic the process, one SQLite writer, and the pieces that keep the service registered. It calls dyno-core for every decision and dyno-platform for every OS access (ADR 0002, 0008, 0010).
